query: What is the punishment for dacoity?

required_points: Section 310 provides that when five or more persons conjointly commit or attempt to commit a robbery, every person so committing, attempting or aiding is said to commit dacoity.
Whoever commits dacoity shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
If any one of the five or more persons who are conjointly committing dacoity commits murder in so doing, every one of those persons shall be punishable with death or imprisonment for life.
forbidden_points: Dacoity can be committed by fewer than five persons.
The punishment for dacoity is always death.
